decisions.recommendation: Yes, once, in the FAQ only: after ‘unlimited dictation and file space’ add EN ‘(with a safety limit of 50 dictations a day)’ / ES ‘(con un límite de seguridad de 50 dictados al día)’ / CA ‘(amb un límit de seguretat de 50 dictats al dia)’. decisions.question: Is TaskFlow's type thin in Safari on your iPhone? In Playwright's WebKit on Windows, all 56 renders draw Manrope at its thinnest weight (200): thin headings and buttons, and small print that nearly disappears. Chromium draws the right weights. The font's default weight is 200 (`public/fonts/Manrope.ttf`). Safari on iPhone uses Core Text, which most likely applies the weights, so this is probably an artifact of the Windows WebKit build, but only a real device can tell, and no agent touches a phone.
decisions.recommendation: Open /, /es/privacy/ and a missing page in Safari on your iPhone (and on a Mac if you have one). If the headings and buttons are bold, close WEB-701 as a Windows-WebKit artifact and note it in `artifacts/ux-web/webkit/INDEX.md`, so future WebKit renders aren't read for weight. If they're thin, a small package loads Manrope as static WOFF2 files for the weights the CSS uses (400, 600, 700, 800), on top of WP22's next/font change. The main session can't answer this one for you: it needs your phone.
